findings.finding: Destination absolute normalized, values Map.copyOf snapshot. prepare skips ANY existing destination path. Select FIRST existing legacy source and return even empty/unrecognized/invalid-value map; malformed first source can block valid later fallback. IOException becomes UncheckedIOException and aborts; no next-source retry. No source mutation/deletion here.

Imports only enableCheatModeForOp/Creative/Give. Lowercase .properties suffix starts inside allowed section; section lines can change that state. Other files require exact cheat mode section name, with optional single/double enclosing quotes stripped. Keys may be quoted. # comments removed before quote parsing, keys/section case-sensitive; boolean literal case-insensitive without quoted-value support. Last VALID duplicate wins; invalid later duplicate logs but does not erase earlier valid. This is a limited parser, not full TOML/properties semantics.

Common schema registers defaults true/true/false, stores pending Optional before activation/create per comments and registered callbacks, later applies then clears pending after normal return. NeoForge source precedence world serverconfig then game defaultconfigs. Fabric selects global config properties for destination current world. Fabric migration phase ordered after default; NeoForge event LOWEST registration observed. Full framework registration, activation order and before-player-join comment not experimentally established.

Apply requires schema active path and lexical absolute normalized equality to captured destination. Reject absent/mismatched active path before batch. No realpath/symlink/world UUID identity check. Updates only imported names in supplied config values; missing/invalid values retain currently active/default values, not forcibly false. Server caller supplies exactly the three booleans. Other settings are not copied.

Existence preflight only at prepare; there is an interval before apply, which has no existence recheck. This allows intended framework-created destination, but does not exclude intervening user/file writes or promise overwrite avoidance. Snapshot source edits after prepare are not reread. No persistent completed marker/journal/transactional rollback here. Pending clears only normal return; apply exception can leave pending set. MezzConfig batch save atomicity, callbacks, durability and retry policy unread. Source preservation does not establish atomic destination update.

Generic path helper orders profile-specific before global but is not used by server import shown. Generic loader word-category regex differs from special cheat mode parser; last raw matching value is handed to serializer. Migrator can context.set from result then reject diagnostics in same invocation. No generic source fallback/framework orchestration proven here; all are supporting reads, zero separate credit.
